    SELECT cust.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America' AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1.cust_city FROM city_sales cs1
    JOIN city_sales cs2 ON cs1.cust_city = cs2.cust_city
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
        AND cs1.total_sales > 0 AND (cs2.total_sales - cs1.total_sales) / cs1.total_sales >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as q_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America' AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
        AND cust.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(q_sales) as total_sales FROM product_sales GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT prod_id, total_sales, quintile, rank
FROM product_ranked
